findings.label: Hardcoded rgba in productor-perfil.scss
findings.description: background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) on .portada-overlay violates the no-hardcoded-colors rule. Replace with a CSS variable such as var(--overlay-dark) defined in styles.scss.

findings.label: Literal white keyword in color-mix (producto-detalle.scss)
findings.description: .exito { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 10%, white) } embeds a hardcoded color keyword. Replace white with var(--surface-white).

findings.label: Producer name missing in ProductoDetalle
findings.description: The spec requires nombre y municipio del productor but the template shows the numeric productorId. Import PRODUCTORES_MOCK and do a find-by-id lookup to display the actual name.

findings.label: Missing (toggleFavorito) output binding in ProductorPerfil
findings.description: <app-producto-card [producto]="p"> in productor-perfil.html omits the output binding. Favorites will silently drop on the profile page. Add (toggleFavorito) binding wired to FavoritosService.toggle.

findings.label: Build not verified
findings.description: No ng build output was recorded. TypeScript and Angular template compilation errors under strictTemplates: true cannot be ruled out without a successful build run.
